approval.note: A storyboard is a script, not footage. scenes.narration: But what if the manager wants to go a step further? The agent handles the analysis and offers a set of targeted recommendations right in their workflow. Work like this used to require cross-referencing different systems by hand. Now, with unified data context across Dynamics 365 ERP and Microsoft Teams, the agent can rapidly generate a phased plan with quick wins. For risk mitigation, the agent helps as well, outlining a strategy that keeps the work on track. When the detail is needed, they simply ask, and the agent quickly compiles a clear summary. It is explicit about what it did not read, so nobody mistakes a gap in the sources for a clean result. It names what it needs from a person before anything is written back, and who owns each step. And it says what would change its answer, which is the difference between a briefing you can act on and one you have to re-check. It can campaign ROI in the same conversation, without anyone switching tools. Finally, the agent creates a monitoring plan, so teams keep the effort aligned to the metrics they are measured on.
The result?, improve HEDIS performance, campaign ROI, and better care gap closure efficiency. Get started on your agentic journey today. Talk to your Microsoft representative to learn more.
